# x402 APIs

> Pay-per-call APIs for AI agents at x402.agiscorecard.com. No account, no API key: each call costs $0.005–$0.02, paid in USDC on Base via the open x402 payment-required protocol. Speaks x402 v2 (current: CAIP-2 network eip155:8453, PAYMENT-REQUIRED/PAYMENT-SIGNATURE/PAYMENT-RESPONSE headers) and v1 (legacy: JSON 402 body, X-PAYMENT header). Failed calls are never charged.

## Paid API endpoints ("exact" scheme, USDC on Base, x402 v2 + v1)
- `GET /api/scan?url=<site>` — agent-readiness scan of any website (robots.txt AI-crawler access, llms.txt, agents.md, JSON-LD structured data, meta, sitemap; 0-100 score with itemized checks and fixes). $0.005/call.
- `GET /api/mcp-check?url=<mcp endpoint>` — MCP server health check (real JSON-RPC initialize + tools/list handshake: protocol version, serverInfo, capabilities, tool docs quality, latency, TLS, auth posture; 0-100 score). $0.005/call.
- `GET /api/wellknown?url=<site>` — well-known agent-discovery audit (.well-known/ai-catalog.json, MCP server card, A2A agent card, llms.txt, agents.md, robots.txt AI-crawler access; scored with pass/warn/fail checks and fix links). $0.005/call.
- `GET /api/llms-extract?url=<site>` — structured extraction of a domain's AI-policy files (llms.txt parsed into title/summary/sections/links, agents.md headings + excerpt, ai.txt, per-AI-crawler robots.txt verdicts, adoption signals). Public hosts only. $0.005/call.
- `GET /api/scan-batch?urls=<a,b,c>` — batch agent-readiness scan of up to 5 comma-separated URLs, run concurrently, full report each. More than 5 URLs → free 400, never charged. $0.02/call.
- `GET /api/mcp-index` — the full current Public MCP Server Index as JSON (every indexed public MCP server with score, grade, latency, tools). Free weekly summary at https://mcppulse.agiscorecard.com. $0.01/call.

## How to pay
1. Call the endpoint with no payment header → HTTP 402. v2 clients: read base64 `PaymentRequired` from the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` response header (network "eip155:8453", amount in atomic USDC units — "5000" = $0.005, "10000" = $0.01, "20000" = $0.02 — asset 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913). v1 clients: the JSON body carries `{ x402Version: 1, accepts: [...] }` with `maxAmountRequired` and network "base".
2. Sign an EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization for the amount; retry with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: base64(v2 PaymentPayload)` (or legacy `X-PAYMENT` for v1).
3. Response 200 carries the result plus `PAYMENT-RESPONSE` (mirrored as `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE`): base64 settlement receipt with tx hash. Client libraries: `@x402/fetch` + `@x402/evm` (current, v2) or `x402-fetch` (legacy, v1) handle the whole flow.

## Discovery
- `GET /.well-known/x402` — machine-readable catalog: path, method, price, network (v2 CAIP-2 + v1 alias), supported x402Versions [1,2], full v2 accepts[] when payments are live.
